_comment: BIGANN-1B (1B, 128d L2, uint8 widened to float32 at load). Same distribution as SIFT-1M but at 1B scale, so parameters mirror diskann_deep1b's 'CPU/RAM are plenty' tier: pq_chunks=64 (2d/chunk, matches SIFT-1M tuning), pruned_degree=96 / max_degree=128 for 1B-scale graph density, l_build=200, num_threads=32, build_ram_limit_gb=192 (1B*128B = 128 GB raw, plus PQ training overhead). search_list_size=300 widens search candidates. Build wall-clock is 1-2 days; this minimises it, not removes it.
